Specification: This module defines a higher-order folding operator over sets. The operator MapThenFoldSet first maps each chosen element x of a set S through a function f, then combines the results with a binary operator op starting from an initial base value. The specification is purely functional and contains no state variables, actions, temporal behavior, fault model, or verification properties; the comments note that if the chooser is nondeterministic, op should be associative and commutative so the result does not depend on the order in which set elements are selected.
IfThenElse: IF s = {} THEN base ELSE LET x == choose(s) IN op(f(x), iter[s \ {x}])
FunctionConstructor: [s \in SUBSET S |-> IF s = {} THEN base ELSE LET x == choose(s) IN op(f(x), iter[s \ {x}])]
